name: zephyr-mqtt-plain

adapter_config.broker_name: Mosquitto 2.x -> Zephyr EviCon firmware (native_sim, plain mode)

system_version: Zephyr v4.2.0 EviCon firmware (native_sim/native/64, -evc_mode=plain) + eclipse-mosquitto:2.0.20 (evicon_review.py records the firmware SHA-256 and the Zephyr revision)

testbed.owner: VM-E zephyr-cutoff.exe -evc_mode=plain (native_sim/native/64, built by deploy/setup/build_iot.sh) + evicon-plant -tcp 127.0.0.1:18092

notes: Run with: python3 evicon_review.py measure zephyr-plain (release 074). The same firmware with no evidence: every delivered command is executed and answered APPLIED; query, fence and stop topics are not subscribed (the adapter's queries and fences go unanswered). Declares nothing. P5 (a resend after 600 s) is left out: P4, P2 and P6 already resend the same identity, and a device without dedup executes every resend. Release 074 (experiment C2): one firmware binary, three evidence modes chosen at start (-evc_mode); the driver starts it with -evc_mode=cutoff|stop|plain, -evc_device=zephyr-1 and VM-B's broker on the command line. Commands are published with QoS 1 (at least once: the usual MQTT command channel, and the call shape of 068-070), the call shape experiment C2 uses.
fault_model: network loss/delay, client abandon; owner up (no owner crash or reboot)
